logistics_claim_resolution_complete.name: logistics_claim_resolution_complete
logistics_claim_resolution_complete.value:
("logistics_claim"."status" in ('open', 'under_review')
             and "logistics_claim"."resolved_by" is null and "logistics_claim"."resolved_at" is null)
          or ("logistics_claim"."status" in ('resolved', 'rejected')
             and "logistics_claim"."resolved_by" is not null and "logistics_claim"."resolved_at" is not null
             and coalesce(btrim("logistics_claim"."resolution"), '') <> '')

          or ("logistics_client_funding"."received_via" = 'client_account' and "logistics_client_funding"."bank_cash_account_id" is null)

crm_activity_has_one_subject_record.name: crm_activity_has_one_subject_record
crm_activity_has_one_subject_record.value:
(case when "crm_activity"."lead_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end
           + case when "crm_activity"."opportunity_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end
           + case when "crm_activity"."partner_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end
           + case when "crm_activity"."case_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end) = 1

crm_campaign_dates_ordered.name: crm_campaign_dates_ordered
crm_campaign_dates_ordered.value: "crm_campaign"."starts_on" is null or "crm_campaign"."ends_on" is null or "crm_campaign"."ends_on" >= "crm_campaign"."starts_on"

crm_case_resolved_is_explained.name: crm_case_resolved_is_explained
crm_case_resolved_is_explained.value:
"crm_case"."status" not in ('resolved', 'closed', 'rejected')
          or ("crm_case"."resolved_on" is not null and coalesce(btrim("crm_case"."resolution"), '') <> '')

project_variation_approved_needs_both.name: project_variation_approved_needs_both
project_variation_approved_needs_both.value:
"project_variation"."status" <> 'approved'
          or ("project_variation"."commercial_approved_by" is not null and "project_variation"."budget_approved_by" is not null)

project_wbs_dates_ordered.name: project_wbs_dates_ordered
project_wbs_dates_ordered.value:
"project_wbs"."planned_starts_on" is null or "project_wbs"."planned_ends_on" is null
          or "project_wbs"."planned_ends_on" >= "project_wbs"."planned_starts_on"
